description: This file defines a migration class for upgrading the OrangeHRM system to version 5.4.0. It includes methods to update language strings, insert modules, set configuration values, create database tables (including OAuth2 tables), and modify existing schemas. It appears to be part of the system's database migration framework, containing both schema manipulations and logic for privilege and configuration setup.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for migrating the OrangeHRM system to version 5.4.0, including database schema updates, configuration settings, and language string updates.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps: updates language strings, inserts modules, sets configuration policies, creates necessary tables, and adjusts schemas for OAuth2 and other features.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, which is '5.4.0'.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Sets the version of language strings for this migration version in the database.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LangStringHelper used for managing language strings.

methods.name: modifyDefaultRequiredPasswordStrength
methods.description: Adjusts the default required password strength setting based on previous configuration values.

methods.name: modifyDefaultPasswordEnforcement
methods.description: Adjusts password enforcement policies based on current configuration values.

methods.name: createOAuth2Tables
methods.description: Creates database tables and initial entries related to OAuth2 clients, authorization codes, access tokens, and refresh tokens, as well as setting related configuration values.

methods.name: changePermissionForAttendanceConfigurationAPI
methods.description: Adds or updates permissions for the attendance configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForTimeConfigPeriodAPI
methods.description: Adds or updates permissions for the time sheet configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForEmployeeWorkShiftAPI
methods.description: Adds or updates permissions for the employee work shift API data group.
